topics.title: Vectors
topics.description: Geometric and algebraic representation of vectors in 2D and 3D space.
objectives: Represent vectors geometrically and as coordinate tuples
Perform vector addition, scalar multiplication
Compute dot product and cross product
Understand magnitude, direction, and unit vectors

topics.title: Matrices
topics.description: Rectangular arrays of numbers representing linear transformations and systems.
objectives: Define matrices and their dimensions
Add and subtract matrices
Understand matrix as a linear transformation
Compute transpose and recognize special matrices

topics.title: Matrix Operations
topics.description: Multiplication, inversion, and determinants of matrices.
objectives: Multiply matrices and understand non-commutativity
Compute the determinant of 2×2 and 3×3 matrices
Find the inverse of a matrix when it exists
Apply properties of determinants

topics.title: Linear Systems
topics.description: Solving systems of linear equations via Gaussian elimination and matrix methods.
objectives: Write a linear system in matrix form Ax=b
Apply row reduction and Gaussian elimination
Determine consistency and the solution set
Understand the geometric interpretation of solutions

topics.title: Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors
topics.description: Special scalars and vectors that reveal intrinsic properties of linear transformations.
objectives: Define eigenvalues and eigenvectors
Compute eigenvalues from the characteristic equation
Find eigenvectors for each eigenvalue
Apply to matrix diagonalization and PCA intuition

topics.title: Vector Spaces
topics.description: Abstract generalization of vectors — sets closed under addition and scalar multiplication.
objectives: State the axioms of a vector space
Identify subspaces, span, and linear independence
Define basis and dimension
Understand null space and column space of a matrix
